title: Performance Max: Advertise Across Marketing Channels - Google Ads

facts.fact: Google's vendor-reported case study states that MuscleSquad reached new customers using Performance Max and achieved 6x ROAS in under three months.
Google's vendor-reported case study states that discovery+ saw 17% incremental subscriber growth using Performance Max.
facts.quote: 17% incremental subscriber growth and a 21% decrease in CPA

facts.fact: Google's vendor-reported case study states that discovery+ saw a 21% decrease in CPA using Performance Max.
facts.quote: 17% incremental subscriber growth and a 21% decrease in CPA

facts.fact: Google's vendor-reported case study states that Kinetica Sports saw a 267% increase in ROAS after using Google Ads.
facts.quote: 267% increase in ROAS and 600% increase in website traffic

facts.fact: Google's vendor-reported case study states that Kinetica Sports saw a 600% increase in website traffic after using Google Ads.
facts.quote: 267% increase in ROAS and 600% increase in website traffic

facts.fact: Google states that Performance Max reaches customers across Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail and Maps.
facts.quote: Reach more converting customers across Search, YouTube, Display, Discover, Gmail and Maps.

facts.fact: Google describes Performance Max as a way to run advertising across all of Google's advertising channels and inventory from a single campaign.
facts.quote: drive better results across all of Google’s advertising channels and inventory from a single campaign.

facts.fact: Google states that multiple campaigns can be created in the same Google Ads account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: Google states that a Google Ads expert will help advertisers set up their first campaign, including designing a media plan and launching with hands-on guidance.
facts.quote: We’ll design a media plan that makes the most of your budget
